title: Genies for Commercial MEP Service Closeout: Turn Technician Notes Into an Invoice-Ready Packet
summary: Use a Genie to connect technician notes, parts evidence and customer acceptance into a reviewable MEP service closeout.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


A commercial MEP service-closeout Genie can assemble technician notes, used-part records, work authorization and customer sign-off into a structured packet. Ask it to distinguish completed work, recommendations, unresolved issues and potential nonbillable activity. Every proposed billing line should point to supporting evidence. The agent can prepare the handoff and identify missing facts, while the service supervisor validates technical meaning and finance controls chargeability and the final financial action.


Explore the complete[commercial HVAC, plumbing and electrical contractors integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/construction/commercial-mep-contractors) for the systems and processes around this guide.
